name: VFACE
description: Classify a patient's facial asymmetry, or measure the change between two scans.

t1.description: The CBCT volumes, one folder, searched recursively. Raw scans for the full pipeline; already-oriented ones for the modes that skip it, which read the frame each was oriented into off its name.
t1.label: CBCT volumes

output_dir.description: Where the measurement tables, the classification and `VFACE_report.json` are written. Nothing is written outside it.

mode.description: How far down the pipeline the scans already are. Full pipeline resamples, orients, segments, registers and measures. File already Oriented starts at the segmentation; File already Registered measures only.
mode.label: Starting from

study.description: An asymmetry assessment has no second scan -- the patient is compared against their own mirror image. A longitudinal study compares the baseline with the follow-up in `t2`.
study.label: Study

outputs.description: Measurements and a classification, heat maps of where the two surfaces differ, or both. Measurements need no segmentation of the soft tissue and heat maps need no landmarks, so a deployment missing one tool can still answer the other half.
outputs.label: What to produce

regions.description: Which regions to measure. Each is worked in the frame it is defined in: the mandible against the cranial base, the maxilla against the occlusal plane.
regions.label: Regions to measure

t2.description: The follow-up CBCTs, for a longitudinal study. Ignored by an asymmetry assessment, which makes its own second scan.
t2.label: Follow-up CBCT volumes

measurements.description: A folder holding one measurement list per region -- an Excel naming, per row, a measurement and the landmarks it is taken on. Matched to its region by the file's name.
measurements.label: Measurement lists (one per region)

feature_template.description: The workbook whose columns name the features the classifier was trained on. It comes from the same training run as `classifier_model`; a template alone gives the feature table, and the verdict on top of it needs the bundle too.
feature_template.label: Feature list the classifier was trained on

registration_transforms.description: The transforms a registration you already made produced, one subfolder per region. What `File already Registered` measures, and what it refuses without -- the orientation transforms beside the scans are a different matrix, and using them would move the landmarks wrongly while the run reported success.
registration_transforms.label: Transforms from a registration you already made

cranial_base_reference.description: An already-oriented case defining the Frankfort horizontal and mid-sagittal frame, to use instead of the one ASO holds for it. Left empty -- the normal case -- ASO orients onto its own.
cranial_base_reference.label: Cranial base orientation reference

maxilla_reference.description: An already-oriented case defining the occlusal and mid-sagittal frame, to use instead of the one ASO holds for it. Left empty -- the normal case -- ASO orients onto its own.
maxilla_reference.label: Maxilla orientation reference

mirror_reference.description: The transform that reflects a scan across the mid-sagittal plane. What an asymmetry assessment compares against.
mirror_reference.label: Mirror transform

segmentation_model.description: A bundle to segment the bone each region is registered on, instead of AMASSS's own. Left empty -- the normal case -- AMASSS uses the model it holds.
segmentation_model.label: Bone segmentation bundle

landmark_model.description: The bundle that places the landmarks every measurement is computed from.
landmark_model.label: CBCT landmark bundle

classifier_model.description: The bundle holding the three asymmetry models.
classifier_model.label: Asymmetry classifier bundle

surface_model.description: The bundle that segments the surfaces a heat map is drawn on.
surface_model.label: Surface segmentation bundle

option_help.ASO: The scans once each sits in the cranial base and maxillary frames, before a mask or a registration is built on them.
option_help.AMASSS: The bone each region's registration is confined to -- what to look at when a registration lands on the wrong anatomy.
option_help.AutoMatrix: The mirrored scan an asymmetry assessment compares the patient against, and the landmarks carried into the registered frame.
option_help.AREG_CBCT: The registration itself, per region: the transform every measurement is taken through.
option_help.ALI_CBCT: The landmarks the measurements are made on. A measurement is no better than the point it is taken from, and nothing downstream reveals a point that landed badly.
option_help.Batch_Dental_Seg: The segmented surfaces the heat maps are painted onto.
